title: 06 Hush: notes
strengths: Nothing to tap and one instruction: the right scope for a one-minute break; 'Breathe in' in Fraunces 300 and '4 of 7' are the right two lines.
slop_signals: A blurry lavender glow orb with film grain as the whole interface: the AI 'calm orb'. Apple's Breathe is a crisp flower, Calm a crisp ring, Finch and Breathwrk flat concentric discs with edges.
Two hairline rings around the orb carry no data; the progress arc with its dot then says '4 of 7' a second time.
'Hush' in bold lavender top-left reads as a logo on a screen that should hold only the breath.
fixes: Draw the breath as a crisp shape with an edge (a disc that scales, or petals) and let its size be the phase; no blur, no grain.
Remove the rings; keep either the arc or the '4 of 7' line.
Drop the wordmark; the time is enough.

references.what: Flat concentric discs with hard edges and the word inside: the shape does the breathing.
Flat rings with 'Inhale' inside on a single colour.
A field of dots that expands, a serif cue below, black: a breath without a glow.
One hairline ring with the instruction below it.
A ring with nodes over a blurred image: the closest shipped look to this piece, and still an edge, not a blob.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay
